fix.note: Also needs the free-skill choice (trainedSkillChoice covering every skill, since the background says 'any one skill of your choice') and grantedFeatId 'enlightenment-in-adversity'.

Handled by the caster-archetype engine, not by a field: casterArchetypes.ts builds basicId `basic-${slug}-spellcasting` for each dedication and summoner-dedication is in SPONTANEOUS_DEDICATIONS, so this feat is what flips the basic tier on and grants the repertoire, cantrips and slots. Every other basic-*-spellcasting record in core.json is equally field-free.

engineFieldsPresent is empty. This is the cleric Battle Harbinger class archetype and it replaces the class wholesale: a different spells-per-day table (max two slots at your highest rank plus two one rank lower), no Resolute Faith, no Miraculous Spell, and the divine font replaced by a battle font of four Bane/Bless slots. None of that reaches the sheet, and battle-harbinger-dedication carries no classArchetype block even though four other dedications do.

fix.note: The existing classArchetype shape can suppress features (resolute-faith, miraculous-spell) but cannot replace a class's spells-per-day table or swap the divine font for a restricted Bane/Bless font - both need new capability.

In the companionGrants registry, which is what delivers the young animal companion (and the archetype's allowance for more than one). The focus-spell trained spell attack modifier and spell DC arrive with the first beastmaster focus feat, and Refocus by tending an animal is flavour.

Changes items you Craft: whoever drinks the blessed healing item gains void resistance 5 (or 10). The resistance lands on the drinker - usually an ally - and the vitality trait is a tag on the item, not a statistic of yours.
Changes poisons you Craft so that the afflicted creature heals less from vitality effects. Entirely an effect on the poisoned target.

In the situationalBonuses registry - the +2/+4/+6 status bonus to damage rolls against the challenged foe, scaling with your proficiency in the skill used. The +4 circumstance bonus witnesses gain to their Will DCs is on their side.
Seven days of downtime and a GM-set Will DC to befriend an ordinary animal that is not a companion. The animal gaining the minion trait is a GM-facing command rule; the character gains no statistic.

Spend a Mythic Point to roll one Recall Knowledge or Earn Income Lore check at mythic proficiency, and regain a point on a critical success while researching. It is a resource spend made at the table, not a standing modifier; the edicts and anathema are roleplay.

In the situationalBonuses registry, which carries the awakening's +1 circumstance bonus to a saving throw. Borrowing the target's skill proficiency depends on statistics of a creature the app does not model, and the second awakening copies whatever special senses that creature happens to have.
